title: Let service become the way across
summary: Service bears fruit when the Guru brings it into the Lord’s pleasure. Let today’s work become remembrance, not self-display.
takeaway: Let service become fruitful by letting the Guru lead it into Naam.
lifeApplication: Choose one act of service without needing it to be noticed, and connect it inwardly to remembrance of Naam.

source.shortMeaning: Service to the Lord is fruitful when the Gurmukh meets the Guru and meditates on Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When the day feels aimless, choose service the Shabad can actually carry.

evidence.coreClaim: Service to the Lord is fruitful when the Gurmukh meets the Guru and meditates on Naam.
evidence.turn: Service becomes a path when it stops seeking approval and starts belonging to the Guru’s direction.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one act of service without needing it to be noticed, and connect it inwardly to remembrance of Naam.
